user.title: RED Movilidad
user.description: How do you want to identify the bus stop?

codigo.title: Bus stop code
codigo.description: Enter the code as shown on the stop sign or in the Red app (for example PA433 or PI369).

buscar_linea.title: Search by route
buscar_linea.description: Enter the route number (for example 506, J10 or 210), then pick a stop along it.

elegir_paradero.title: Choose a stop
elegir_paradero.description: Stops along the route, both directions.

linea.title: Filter by route (optional)
linea.description:
Stop {paradero} - {nombre}.

Leave the route blank to choose between two sensors with the nearest arrivals of any route, or one pair of sensors per route at the stop.

error.codigo_invalido: The code does not look valid (letters + number, e.g. PA433).
error.api_no_disponible: Could not reach red.cl. The predictor fails often: try again in a few seconds.
error.linea_desconocida: That route is not in Red's service list.
error.sin_resultados: No stops found for that route.

abort.already_configured: That stop is already configured with that route or mode.

init.title: Change route or mode
init.description:
Stop {paradero} - {nombre}.

Leave the route blank to choose the sensor mode.
